title: 射击游戏
problem_statement_md:
你正在编写一个射击游戏!
游戏有两种类型的敌人，外星人**aliens**和怪物**monsters**。你用激光器**laser**射击外星人，用你的枪**gun**射击怪物。

每击中一次，敌人的生命就会减少1。
给定的代码声明了一个通用的敌人**Enemy**类，以及外星人**Alien**和怪物**Monster**类，以及它们相应的生命值。还定义了敌人类的**hit**()方法。

你需要做以下工作来完成这个程序:
1.**Alien**和**Monster**类继承自**Enemy**类。
2.完成while循环，连续从用户输入中获取选择的武器**laser**(激光器) 或 **gun**(抢)，并调用相应对象的`hit()`方法。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Shooting Game[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are creating a shooting game! 
The game has two types of enemies, [b]aliens[/b] and [b]monsters[/b]. You shoot the aliens using your [b]laser[/b], and monsters using your [b]gun[/b].
Each hit decreases the lives of the enemies by 1. 
The given code declares a generic [b]Enemy[/b] class, as well as the [b]Alien[/b] and [b]Monster[/b] classes, with their corresponding lives count.
It also defines the [b]hit[/b]() method for the Enemy class.

You need to do the following to complete the program:
1. Inherit the [b]Alien[/b] and [b]Monster[/b] classes from the [b]Enemy[/b] class. 
2. Complete the while loop that continuously takes the weapon of choice from user input and call the corresponding object's hit() method.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
laser
laser
gun
exit

[b]Sample Output[/b]
Alien has 4 lives
Alien has 3 lives
Monster has 2 lives

[note]The while loop stops when the user enters '[b]exit[/b]'.[/note]
hint_md: 当用户输入**exit**时，while循环停止。

Alien has 3 lives
Monster has 2 lives
